build_pose_estimator: build a pose estimator model with backbone, neck, and head components using BasePoseEstimator
forward_pose_predict: run the forward pass in predict mode to get pose predictions from input tensors
extract_pose_features: extract multi-level features from input images using the backbone and neck modules
load_metainfo_pose: load and parse pose meta information including keypoints definition and properties
migrate_state_dict: migrate old version state dict keys from keypoint_head to head format for compatibility
